title: Yin Yoga in Coburg | Yoga Momente
description: Yin yoga in Coburg: deep, relaxed holding of poses for joints, fascia and calm. Classes with Susanne Müller, also online.

sections.title: Yin Yoga
sections.lead: Relax deeply, become supple, find calm.

sections.title: Yin Yoga: what to expect.
paragraphs: Keeps your body deeply supple and lets life energy flow through joints, fascia and meridian tissue. Yin yoga means holding deeply effective poses for longer in complete relaxation, for everyone who enjoys taking their practice to a higher level of mindfulness and stillness. An ideal balance for everyone whose daily life is more yang-oriented – in other words, very active.

items.title: As a single class
items.text: On demand within **Personal Yoga**: one-to-one with Susanne, on request in the studio in Coburg or at your home.

items.title: In group classes
items.text: Yin elements are part of the group classes, for example the regular weekly class and **Early Morning Yoga**.

items.title: Who it is for
items.text: For beginners and advanced practitioners, as a balance for everyone whose daily life is rather yang-oriented. Bolsters, blocks and straps support you.

sections.title: Start with a trial class.
sections.text: One trial class of 60 minutes for €60. Write to us and we will arrange your appointment.
